# How to Create Video by Project with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to start video generation from an existing flyworks provider project, including setup, request fields, tool approval,…

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_create_video_by_project`

## Prompt

```text
Use Medux to run Create Video by Project. Review the required inputs, call medux_create_video_by_project, wait for the result if a task is returned, and report the output clearly.
```

## Review before approval

- `project_id` (optional): Provide the value described in the API reference.
- `title` (optional): Provide the value described in the API reference.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
